facts.text: Located in the Vanqor system in the far reaches of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, Vanqor was a temperate, rocky, and overcast planet with a surface marked by smoky crystalline formations.

evidence.quote: Located in the Vanqor system in the far reaches of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, Vanqor was a temperate, rocky, and overcast planet with a surface marked by smoky crystalline formations.

facts.text: Swirling silica-dust storms caused the world to have a blue-gray hue when viewed from space.

evidence.quote: Swirling silica-dust storms caused the world to have a blue-gray hue when viewed from space.

facts.text: Vanqor was located six parsecs away from the closest planet, Florrum, and was the homeworld of the gundarks, fierce, aggressive creatures known for their overwhelming strength who inhabited the planet's caves.

evidence.quote: Vanqor was located six parsecs away from the closest planet, Florrum, and was the homeworld of the gundarks, fierce, aggressive creatures known for their overwhelming strength who inhabited the planet's caves.

facts.text: Also inhabiting some of Vanqor's caves were bio-luminescent organisms that lived on the cave walls.

evidence.quote: Also inhabiting some of Vanqor's caves were bio-luminescent organisms that lived on the cave walls.

facts.text: In the year 21 BBY, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Knight Anakin Skywalker shot down Count Dooku, leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, over Vanqor, forcing him to crash-land his ship on the planet's surface.

evidence.quote: In the year 21 BBY, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Knight Anakin Skywalker shot down Count Dooku, leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, over Vanqor, forcing him to crash-land his ship on the planet's surface.

facts.text: However, their shuttle was also forced down during the ensuing battle.

evidence.quote: However, their shuttle was also forced down during the ensuing battle.

facts.text: While using the Force to reopen the entrance and build a barricade, the Jedi accidentally opened a fissure and noxious green gas began filling the cavern.

evidence.quote: While using the Force to reopen the entrance and build a barricade, the Jedi accidentally opened a fissure and noxious green gas began filling the cavern.

facts.text: As the pair tried to dig their way out of the collapsed opening, the gas began to overwhelm them and they collapsed just as the cavern entrance exploded from outside as Skywalker's Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, and her clone forces blasted the cave open.

facts.text: Vanqor, "a large, multicolored planet," had two red moons that orbited in tandem.

evidence.quote: Vanqor, "a large, multicolored planet," had two red moons that orbited in tandem.

facts.text: Flanked by dry, high plateaus, Vanqor's cities were mid-size, strung out along its few fertile valleys.

evidence.quote: Flanked by dry, high plateaus, Vanqor's cities were mid-size, strung out along its few fertile valleys.

facts.text: Its citizens, called "Vanqors," dressed simply, in gray tunics, and didn't adorn their clothing.

evidence.quote: Its citizens, called "Vanqors," dressed simply, in gray tunics, and didn't adorn their clothing.

facts.text: The planet's rugged terrain included a remote area that had been hit by a meteor shower thousands of years in its past: the "Tomo Craters" was the name given to this section of dry land marked by deep craters and fissures.

evidence.quote: The planet's rugged terrain included a remote area that had been hit by a meteor shower thousands of years in its past: the "Tomo Craters" was the name given to this section of dry land marked by deep craters and fissures.

facts.text: It was also the location of a detention facility—"The Tomo Camp"—which retained prisoners from other worlds in the Uziel system, planets already conquered by Vanqor.

evidence.quote: It was also the location of a detention facility—"The Tomo Camp"—which retained prisoners from other worlds in the Uziel system, planets already conquered by Vanqor.

facts.text: A few years prior to the Clone Wars, Vanqor's rulers began an expansionist enterprise of invasion and conquest that led them to controlling the entire Uziel system, except for the planet Typha-Dor.

facts.text: Later, in their investigations of the planet, the Jedi Master-Padawan team fought off a nest of gundarks deep in the Tomo Craters.

facts.text: Warship forces under the command of Typha-Dor High General Bycha took advantage of the concealment afforded by Typha-Dor's "string of moons" before suddenly appearing to ensnare Vanqor's invasion fleet within the satellite corridor through which its invasion forces intended to pass.
